adaptationNotes: Only overlay terms that do not need a source image (grain, static flecks, tracking band, vignette) are reusable; see snippets/crt-overlay.
name: VHS Overlay
notes:
Degraded VHS tape + CRT monitor effect for Ghostty by Alex Brinsmead (gist be7d2d2209d0dd3097000af369867927), MIT licensed with the full notice in the file. Preserved from 0xhckr/ghostty-shaders `85898f0`.

Post-process shader; the texture-free terms (grain, static, tracking band, vignette) can be multiplied or added over procedural colour.
requirements: post-process: samples iChannel0 terminal texture several times
summary: Alex Brinsmead's MIT degraded-VHS and CRT post-process for Ghostty; grain and tracking pieces feed the crt-overlay snippet.
